tutorial.quickstart.steps.addPipe.conten: Add a pipe from your collection. Take a photo and fill in details like shape, maker, and material.
tutorial.quickstart.steps.addPipe.tip: Even basic info helps. You can always add more details later.
tutorial.quickstart.steps.addTobacco.tit: Quick Start: Add Your First Blend
tutorial.quickstart.steps.addTobacco.con: Add a tobacco blend. Include the type, strength, and how much you have on hand.
tutorial.quickstart.steps.addTobacco.tip: Even one pipe and one blend unlocks matching recommendations.
tutorial.quickstart.steps.logSession.tit: Quick Start: Log Your First Session
tutorial.quickstart.steps.logSession.con: Log a smoking session. When and what you smoked helps PipeKeeper learn your preferences.
tutorial.quickstart.steps.logSession.tip: Find 'Log Session' on your Home page to get started.
